source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1.Set COM0 Console redirection enable. There should be console redirection for detail setting. Reboot to check if there is output in console.
2.Set COM0 Console redirection disable. Reboot to check if there is no output in console.
3. Set Terminal Type to ANSI/VT100/VT100+/VT-UTF8 and check output of console and be able to control SUT via keyboard.
4. Set Bits per second to 115200/9600/19200/38400/57600 and check output of console and be able to control SUT via keyboard.
5. Repeat step 1~4 on all available COM.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. Output of console should be human readable
2. Should be able to control SUT in console mode via keyboard.

original_test_intent: Validate console redirection for COM0 and every available COM: enabled output must be readable and accept keyboard control across ANSI, VT100, VT100+, VT-UTF8 and all five baud rates; disabled state must emit no console output.
original_method: Map each COM endpoint, configure one approved redirection/terminal/baud state in BIOS, reboot, capture raw bytes and rendered output, inject only a predefined harmless keyboard sequence, verify response, repeat the matrix, test disabled silence and restore baseline.
manual_activity: An engineer must map/connect the console, apply/confirm BIOS settings and supervise save/reboot. With the endpoint established, capture, readability indicators and approved non-destructive keyboard-response checks can be scripted.
required_inputs: Terminal emulator supporting the four source modes
Five baud settings plus framing/flow control
Safe keyboard stimulus and expected response
safety_requirements: Never send arbitrary keys to an unidentified console target.
Do not alter the sole recovery/management path without independent OOB access.
Stop on garbled output, wrong target or lost management.
No automatic retry; preserve the first failure.
agent_execution_scope: Prepare the full Cartesian coverage matrix and verify endpoint identity.
After approved setup, record raw/rendered output and send only the approved harmless key sequence.
Measure disabled-state silence and collect OOB/OS logs without issuing PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve mappings, terminal package, key stimulus and reboot plan.
Apply/confirm BIOS states and physical/SOL connection.
Review human readability/control evidence, restore baseline and issue verdict.

project_override_considerations: If the project approves fewer physical ports or combinations, report exact executed coverage and do not claim the source's all-port/full-matrix coverage completed.

Raw and rendered readable boot output
Disabled-state silence with known capture health
OOB recovery, baseline restoration and engineer verdict
